description: TRAVERSE CITY, Mich., Oct. 6, 2025 — As part of her continued efforts to facilitate a transparent process surrounding the Michigan Department of Natural Resources’ (DNR) plans to replace the pedestrian bridge over U.S. Highway 31 near the Keith J. Charters Traverse City State Park, state Rep. Betsy Coffia (D-Traverse City) recently posed several questions to the DNR regarding the project and is sharing their responses with the public.

title: Coffia Provides Additional Updates on Traverse City Pedestrian Bridge Replacement | Betsy Coffia
